node.title: Low-budget rate-half list certificate generator
node.statement: The deterministic fail-closed generator maps an exact canonical rate-half row input with B*=floor(|F|/2^128) in {1,2} and an explicit LIST or INTERLEAVED_LIST selector to a self-contained prize-facing adjacent certificate. It records arity one or all positive common-support arities respectively, canonical descriptor and external preconditions, theorem provenance, proved ledgers, compiler input/output, safe agreement 3n/4, radius numerator n/4, and the unattained unsafe boundary n/4+1. Every unsupported rate, budget, object, or row shape is refused.
